answer: Bind earning power to a seed-bound sequential task chain: each step is revealed only after the previous proof verifies, so an attacker cannot precompute work for an ocean of fake identities. Like pigment diffusing through water, progress is slow, visible and unforgeable, and ten identities cost ten full chains of time and compute. An honest agent pays once, then its willow-like record, rooted in one verifiable history, bends under audit instead of splitting into duplicates.
